profile.headline: Software Engineer at Red Hat | I develop things: web things, accessible things, responsive things.
profile.summary:
With a degree in Accounting and over 4 years working as an auditor in the health insurance industry, I have shifted to and thoroughly enjoy being a software engineer. I started as a self-learner thanks to The Odin Project (TOP), an open-source curriculum that helps users learn programming skills via web development.

One particular focus that I've taken on since starting my journey has been accessibility, both in learning more of it myself and helping others understand the importance of it. As someone with an eye disease, I am dedicated to creating websites and apps that are accessible to as wide of an audience as possible. 

My belief is that we create content for users, and users with visual impairments, hearing loss, and cognitive disabilities (just to name a few) are still users.

projects.title: Onward to Mathventure
projects.description:
An edutainment game aimed at 3rd graders, created as a team collaboration for The Odin Project's first ever game jam.

The main focus of the game is addition and subtraction of 2-3 digit numbers, multiplication, simple division, and the order of operations. The theme of the game is an old school 8-bit adventuring game, where you have to collect items in order to gain access to the boss of the game: the evil Magetician.

With over 150 questions randomly chosen and 3 different areas of question-asking NPC's (not including the Magetician's lair), Onward to Mathventure can be played more than once to help learn a little more math each time.

projects.title: Enbious
projects.description:
An accessible shopping cart app built with React.

- Uses routing for the different pages as well as functional components and various hooks, including useReducer.

- Implemented a stock-to-quantity check when attempting to add low-stock items to your cart.

- Items are rendered with a warning when items are low in stock or are completely sold out.

- Updates to the cart are easy and render immediately. No dropdowns, no extra clicking needed.

- Deployed with Netlify.
